headline: Everpeak Plastics signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Everpeak Plastics announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.

headline: Everpeak Plastics cuts guidance after margin squeeze
body: Everpeak Plastics lowered full-year guidance, citing margin pressure from raw material costs and weaker pricing power.

headline: Everpeak Plastics under fraud investigation over inflated invoices
body: Prosecutors are investigating Everpeak Plastics over allegations of inflated invoicing to customers. The company denies wrongdoing, but two customers have paused orders.

headline: Everpeak Plastics reports record quarterly revenue
body: Everpeak Plastics reported revenue growth of 7% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Everpeak Plastics announces layoffs affecting 12% of workforce
body: Everpeak Plastics said it will cut 12% of its workforce as part of a cost reduction program. Unions criticized the lack of consultation.

headline: Everpeak Plastics to present at regional manufacturing conference
body: Everpeak Plastics will present on supply chain practices at a regional conference in Gdansk. Executives are scheduled to take questions from attendees.

headline: Lenders flag covenant breach at Everpeak Plastics, bankruptcy rumors grow
body: Lenders to Everpeak Plastics have flagged a covenant breach and are negotiating a standstill. Market commentary has raised the possibility of insolvency proceedings.
